metadata.title: Wesley — Web Developer
metadata.description: Django, Next.js and end-to-end e-commerce. I turn ideas into products that work.

hero.desc: Django, Next.js and end-to-end e-commerce. I turn ideas into products that work — from the backend to the very last frontend animation.

caseStudies.label: Alva Personal Care · Current role
caseStudies.title: Compre Alva — B2B Portal & E-commerce
caseStudies.desc: Complete digital platform for Alva Personal Care retailers, unifying B2B e-commerce, self-service, ticket management and ERP integration into a single ecosystem. I worked mainly on the backend (Django/DRF) and owned the e-commerce module end to end — data modeling, business rules, APIs and integrations.

stats.label: commits in the monorepo (team of 3 devs)
commits authored by me — top contributor
external integrations: Omie ERP, Datafrete and SendGrid

highlights: Generic cart/checkout architecture (GenericForeignKey): the same engine powers live shopping, campaigns, promotions and the store without duplication
Full catalog with per-customer price tables, enabled SKUs, media and specifications
Storefront CMS with dynamic blocks configurable from the admin — banners, sliders, reels and menus
Promotion engine: coupons, gifts by value and quantity, conditional free shipping
Bidirectional integration with the Omie ERP: electronic invoices, payment slips and idempotent webhooks
Help desk with configurable workflows, dynamic fields and multichannel notifications

caseStudies.label: Alva Personal Care · Current role
caseStudies.title: Alva Personal Care — Complete Shopify theme
caseStudies.desc: Custom theme built on Dawn for a Brazilian natural cosmetics brand: from the home page to seasonal campaign pages, cashback program and careers area. Proprietary typography (SeivaDisplay), a metafield system for tags, videos and related products, and reusable components spread across the entire store.

stats.label: Liquid sections and snippets built from scratch
institutional pages with their own template
valid rich results on homepage (Google) — Schema.org built from scratch, 0 errors

highlights: Custom mega menu with hover/click logic and independent submenus
Carousels and banners with start/end date scheduling
Product card with automatic discount badge, metafield-driven swatches and image swap on hover
Product gallery with synced thumbnails and dynamic information
Goal progress bar in the cart (“R$ X to go for the free gift”)
Reels-style video grids with play and mute controls
Structured data (Schema.org) from scratch: Product, BreadcrumbList, ItemList and Organization — 0 errors in the official validator; star ratings, prices and rich results already live on Google Search

caseStudies.label: Alva Group · Current role
caseStudies.title: Good Mood — Shopify E-commerce
caseStudies.desc: Full build of the Good Mood Shopify store — a brand from the same group as Alva Personal Care — starting from Dawn 15.4.1 and turning it into a tailor-made theme: visual identity with proprietary fonts (Seiva Display and Seiva Poster), 100% custom home and institutional pages with editor-configurable sections, a conversion-driven PDP and analytics instrumentation via Google Tag Manager.

stats.label: valid rich results on homepage (Google) — Schema.org built from scratch, 0 errors

highlights: Brand design system: 12 named colors in the global settings and 2,000+ refined lines in base.css
Fully custom home: hero slider, infinite marquee, kit showcases, reels-style video slider and Instagram feed
One-page 'About' with 10 exclusive sections, including the brand timeline
Conversion PDP: benefit blocks, tabs, stock status, size guide modal and Judge.me
Redesigned cart drawer with progress bar and custom-art empty state
Global floating WhatsApp button and restyled FAQ, policy and blog templates
Structured data (Schema.org) from scratch: Product (price detected), BreadcrumbList, ItemList — 0 errors; review snippets and merchant listings already live on Google Search

cards.title: PegaBox
cards.desc: Startup concept created at a startup event: smart residential lockers by subscription, tackling last-mile delivery in Brazil. Field research with 90+ respondents and three subscription plans.

cards.title: Tax data enrichment — TIPI
cards.desc: Django pipeline to populate IPI tax rates by matching product NCM codes against the official TIPI table from Brazil's Federal Revenue Service.

about.p1: I'm a developer from Joinville, Brazil, born in November 1996, focused on e-commerce and digital products. I currently work as a full-stack dev at Alva Personal Care, from the database to the pixel: backend architecture in Django, interfaces in Next.js and deep Shopify customizations.
about.p2: I also have experience with WordPress and Tray stores, plus integrations with Bling, Omie and REST APIs in general.

education.title: Technical degree in Systems Analysis and Development
